notes: Step 1 parts were correct and are unchanged: 5 jumper wires (the manual says three, but the image also shows two short jumpers).

The image's pushbutton legs are in columns 4 and 6. The legs in the same column (across the gap) are joined inside the button. I mapped the catalogue's side 1 (1.l, 1.r) to column 6 (top and bottom) and side 2 (2.l, 2.r) to column 4.
Column 6 carries pin 2 and the pull-down resistor. Column 4 goes to 5V through the orange jumper, so pressing the button gives HIGH on pin 2.
The resistor spans columns 6 and 9 on the bottom half, and the short black jumper from column 9 goes to the ground rail.
Rail holes 'bp' (the + row) and 'bn' (the - row) are the bottom power rails. The exact hole numbers (bp.2, bn.2, bp.4, bn.9) are approximate from the image.
The red wire goes to the Uno 5V pin and the black wire to GND.2, as drawn.
